blurb.en: Three things at once: read a line, keep it in a variable, print it back inside an f-string.
blurb.zh: 一次装三件事：读一行、存进变量、用 f-string 打回去。

en: input() always hands you a str, whatever the person typed. Type 42 and you get the two characters "42", not the number. Almost every week-one bug of the form "why is my arithmetic wrong" traces back to this one sentence.

The f-string is preferred over "Hello, " + name + "!" for a reason that shows up later rather than here: concatenation needs str() around anything that is not already a string, and the sentence gets harder to read every time you add a piece. The f-string keeps the sentence looking like a sentence.

Note the first line of the output: the prompt passed to input() is written to standard output with no newline after it, so the greeting lands on the same line as the question mark. That is not a quirk of this program, it is what the prompt argument does.
zh: input() 交给你的永远是 str，不管对方敲了什么。她敲 42，你拿到的是 "42" 这两个字符，不是数字。开学第一周几乎所有「我的算术怎么算错了」，源头都是这一句。
这里用 f-string 而不是 "Hello, " + name + "!"，理由不在这一行、在以后：拼接要给每个非字符串的东西套上 str()，而且每多拼一段，那句话就更难读一分。f-string 让一句话看上去还是一句话。
注意输出的第一行：传给 input() 的提示串是写到标准输出的，后面不换行，所以问候语落在问号的同一行上。这不是本程序的怪癖，这就是提示参数的行为。

lineNotes.en: The braces are evaluated, not printed. Anything inside them is an expression, which is why len(who) works in the line below.
lineNotes.zh: 花括号里的东西是被求值的，不是被原样打印的。里面放的是表达式——所以下面那行的 len(who) 才能直接写进去。

lineNotes.en: The work of asking is in main, the work of composing the sentence is in greet(). Separating them is what lets a gate call greet("Ada") without a keyboard.
lineNotes.zh: 「问」在 main 里，「拼句子」在 greet() 里。把两件事分开，校验门才能在没有键盘的情况下直接调 greet("Ada")。

run.expect:
What is your name? Hello, Ada!
Your name has 3 letters.

blurb.en: One formula, and the two things Python does with numbers that surprise everyone once.
blurb.zh: 一个公式，外加 Python 处理数字时那两件每个人都会被绊一次的事。

en: In Python 3 the / operator always produces a float, even when it divides evenly: 4 / 2 is 2.0, not 2. That is why 0C prints as 32.0F and not 32F. If you wanted a whole number you would have to ask for one; Python will not quietly give you one back.

Look at 36.6C. The answer prints as 97.88000000000001. Nothing is broken: 36.6 has no exact binary representation, so the multiplication carries a tiny error that the division then scales. This is the reason marks, money and temperatures get round() applied at the moment they are displayed, and never in the middle of a chain of calculations, where rounding twice quietly moves the answer.

round() has a detail worth knowing before you need it: round(x) with no second argument returns an int, round(x, 1) returns a float. Same function, two different types out, decided by whether you asked for decimal places.
zh: Python 3 里 / 的结果永远是 float，哪怕除得尽：4 / 2 是 2.0，不是 2。所以 0C 打出来是 32.0F 而不是 32F。想要整数你得自己开口要，Python 不会偷偷还你一个。
看 36.6C 那一行，答案打成了 97.88000000000001。没有东西坏掉：36.6 在二进制里没有精确写法，乘法带进一点误差，除法又把它放大了一点。这正是分数、金额、温度都在「要显示的那一刻」才 round()、而绝不在算式中间 round() 的理由——中途 round 两次，答案会悄悄挪位。
round() 有个细节值得在需要它之前就知道：round(x) 不带第二个参数返回 int，round(x, 1) 返回 float。同一个函数，出来两种类型，取决于你有没有问它要小数位。

lineNotes.en: Written 9 / 5 rather than 9 // 5 on purpose: floor division would make that factor 1 and every answer wrong by the same silent amount.
lineNotes.zh: 这里刻意写 9 / 5 而不是 9 // 5：整除会把这个系数变成 1，于是每个答案都以同一个静悄悄的幅度错掉。

lineNotes.en: No second argument, so this one comes back as an int: 98, not 98.0. Compare with the line above it.
lineNotes.zh: 没有第二个参数，所以这次回来的是 int：98，不是 98.0。和上面那行对着看。

title.en: Largest of Three: if / elif / else

blurb.en: The branch chain written out by hand, so you can see which comparison each branch is allowed to skip.
blurb.zh: 把分支链一条条写出来，好看清每个分支各自能省掉哪一次比较。

en: The second branch never mentions a. It does not need to: reaching that branch already proves the first test failed, so a has already lost and only the other two are still in the running. Every branch in a chain inherits the negation of every branch above it, and using that is what keeps the chain from growing to nine conditions.

An if / elif / else chain has a property that three separate if statements do not: exactly one branch runs, so largest is assigned exactly once and always. Write it as three independent ifs, forget the final else, and Python will not warn you. You find out at run time, with a NameError, and only on the inputs that happen to reach that path.

This version and its sibling max-of-three-builtin return the same answers for every input. They are not competing; the exam asks you to show the algorithm, and this is what the algorithm looks like when nothing is hidden inside a built-in.
zh: 第二个分支完全没提 a。它不需要提：能走到那个分支，本身就证明了第一个判断为假，也就是 a 已经出局，只剩另外两个还在比。链条里每个分支都免费继承了上面所有分支的否定，用上这一点，才不至于把这条链写成九个条件。
if / elif / else 链有一个三条独立 if 没有的性质：恰好一个分支会执行，所以 largest 恰好被赋值一次、而且一定被赋值。写成三条独立的 if、再忘掉最后的 else，Python 不会警告你。你会在运行时才发现，以 NameError 的形式，而且只在恰好走到那条路的输入上才发现。
这一版和它的兄弟 max-of-three-builtin 对任何输入都给同样的答案。它们不是在竞争：卷子要你把算法写出来，而算法在没有任何东西藏进内置函数时，长的就是这个样子。

lineNotes.at: if a >= b and a >= c:
lineNotes.en: and short-circuits: if a >= b is already False, a >= c is never evaluated. Free, and it is why the cheapest test goes first.
lineNotes.zh: and 是短路的：只要 a >= b 已经为假，a >= c 根本不会被求值。这是白送的，也正是「最便宜的判断放前面」的理由。

lineNotes.en: This line can only be reached with largest already assigned, and that guarantee comes from the chain above ending in a branch with no condition on it. A chain that ends on a condition instead has a path where nothing is assigned, and the failure arrives here, one line later, as a NameError.
lineNotes.zh: 能走到这一行，largest 就一定已经被赋过值了，而这条保证来自上面那条链**以一个不带条件的分支收尾**。若那条链是以一个带条件的分支结束的，就存在一条什么都没赋值的路径，而失败会在这里、在晚一行的地方，以 NameError 的形式出现。

blurb.en: The same answers as the branch version in one line, plus the two shapes of max() worth telling apart.
blurb.zh: 和分支版一模一样的答案，一行写完；外加 max() 那两种值得分清的用法。

en: max() has two forms and they behave differently at the edges: it takes either several separate arguments, or a single iterable such as a list. This program uses the first form: its three parameters go in as three separate arguments. The difference shows at the edge, where only the iterable form can be handed nothing: max([]) raises ValueError while max([], default=None) returns None. An empty list is the case that separates the two forms, and it is the case a marker will hand you.

If max() exists, why write the if version at all? Because the exam asks for the algorithm, and because the day the rule changes to "largest by absolute value" you need to add key=abs to that same call. That only makes sense to someone who already knows what the branches were doing.

This is also a lesson in what a built-in is: max is not magic, it is the same comparison loop written once, in C, by someone who then had to get the empty case right. You get to reuse their decision instead of making it again.
zh: max() 有两种形态，边界上表现不同：要么收若干个分开的参数，要么收一个可迭代对象（比如一个列表）。本程序用的是前一种：三个参数原样分开传进去。差别出在边界上——只有可迭代的那种形态能被递进一个空的东西：max([]) 会抛 ValueError，而 max([], default=None) 返回 None。空列表正是分开这两种形态的那个情形，也正是改卷人会递到你手上的那个情形。
既然有 max()，为什么还要写 if 版？因为卷子要的是算法；也因为哪天规则改成「按绝对值取大」，你要在同一个调用里再加上 key=abs——而这句话只对已经知道那些分支在干什么的人才讲得通。
这还是一课关于「内置函数是什么」：max 不是魔法，它就是同一个比较循环，被人用 C 写了一次，而且那个人当时不得不把空集的情况想清楚。你得以复用他的决定，而不必重新做一遍。

lineNotes.en: Three arguments, not one list. max((a, b, c)) would also work; max(a) would not, because an int is not iterable.
lineNotes.zh: 是三个参数，不是一个列表。max((a, b, c)) 也行；max(a) 不行，因为一个 int 不可迭代。

blurb.en: The version every other language makes you write, and the reason the temporary is not ceremony.
blurb.zh: 别的语言逼你写的那一版；以及为什么那个临时变量不是走过场。

en: Try it without temp and the failure is instructive: copying b into a overwrites a, and the old value of a is gone before anything can copy it across into b. Both variables end up holding b. The temporary is not politeness, it is the only surviving copy.

The function assigns to a and b, and the caller's x and y are untouched by that. Parameters are names bound inside the function; rebinding them rebinds nothing outside. This is why the swap has to be returned, and why the caller has to assign the result back to x and y itself. Students who expect the swap to happen in place are not being careless, they are carrying a habit over from languages that pass by reference.
return a, b builds a tuple on the way out, and the caller unpacks it on the way in. Which is exactly the mechanism the sibling program swap-two-tuple uses to do the whole job in one line.
zh: 把 temp 去掉试一次，失败的方式很有教益：把 b 抄进 a 的那一下就把 a 覆盖掉了，a 的旧值还没来得及抄进 b 就已经没了。两个变量最后都装着 b。那个临时变量不是客套，它是唯一幸存的那份副本。
函数里给 a 和 b 赋了值，调用方的 x 和 y 却毫发无损。参数是绑在函数内部的名字，重新绑定它们，函数外面什么都不会变。这正是交换必须被 return 出来、调用方必须亲手把结果赋回 x 和 y 的原因。以为交换会就地发生的学生不是粗心，他们是带着「传引用」那类语言的习惯过来的。
return a, b 在出去的路上打包成一个元组，调用方在进来的路上把它拆开。而这恰好就是兄弟程序 swap-two-tuple 用来一行办完全部事情的那套机制。

lineNotes.en: This line must come first. It is the only place the original a survives.
lineNotes.zh: 这一行必须在最前面。它是 a 的原值唯一活下来的地方。

lineNotes.en: Reading temp, not a. By now a already holds b's value.
lineNotes.zh: 读的是 temp，不是 a。到这一步，a 装的已经是 b 的值了。

lineNotes.en: The assignment back is not optional. Drop it and the program prints 1 2 twice.
lineNotes.zh: 这一次赋回不是可选的。去掉它，程序会把 1 2 打两遍。

blurb.en: One line, and it works for a reason that is worth more than the line itself.
blurb.zh: 一行搞定；而它成立的理由，比这一行本身更值钱。

en: The one-line swap is not a special swap syntax. The rule is general: the whole right-hand side is evaluated first, into a tuple, and only then is it unpacked into the names on the left. By the time anything is assigned, both old values are already held safely in that tuple. Python made the temporary for you.

Because the rule is general, it explains things that look unrelated. Advancing a Fibonacci pair in one line - the new first value is the old second, the new second is the sum of the two - is correct for the same reason. And it explains why the one-line swap and a = b followed by b = a are not two spellings of one idea: the second pair evaluates in sequence, the first does not.

Compare this with swap-two-temp and notice what is actually different. Not the number of lines: what changed is who makes the copy. Writing the temporary yourself is the same algorithm with the mechanism visible.
zh: 这一行交换不是某种专门的交换语法。这条规则是通用的：等号右边整体先求值、打包成一个元组，然后才拆开赋给左边的名字。轮到赋值发生时，两个旧值早已安稳地待在那个元组里。临时变量是 Python 替你造的。
正因为规则是通用的，它能解释一些看上去毫不相干的事。一行推进一对斐波那契数——新的第一个是旧的第二个，新的第二个是两者之和——成立的是同一条理由。它也解释了为什么这一行交换和「先 a = b 再 b = a」不是同一个意思的两种写法：后者是按顺序求值的，前者不是。
和 swap-two-temp 对着看，注意真正的差别在哪。不在行数：变的是「谁来造那份副本」。自己写那个临时变量，是同一个算法，只是把机制摆在了明处。

lineNotes.en: Right side first: (b, a) is built as a tuple, then unpacked. No name on the left is touched until the tuple exists.
lineNotes.zh: 右边先来：(b, a) 先被造成一个元组，然后才被拆开。在那个元组存在之前，左边任何名字都不会被动过。

blurb.en: A counter, a loop and a membership test - the shape almost every counting problem takes.
blurb.zh: 一个计数器、一个循环、一次成员测试——几乎所有计数问题都是这个形状。

en: The counter is zeroed before the loop, not inside it. Move total = 0 one line down and the program still runs, still prints three numbers, and is wrong: the count resets on every character, so the answer can only ever be 0 or 1. It is the most common counting bug there is, and it never raises an error.

Testing a character with in against the string vowels is a membership test on a string, which means substring search. It works here only because every vowel happens to be one character long. The same operator will tell you that "gram" in "Programming" is True. The moment the things you are looking for grow past one character, this is where the bug comes from, and the fix is to put them in a set or a list instead of a string.

Feed it the empty string and the loop body runs zero times, so the function returns the 0 it started with. A loop that never executes is a normal correct outcome, not an edge case to special-case with an if at the top. Getting that reflex right early saves a lot of unnecessary guarding later.
zh: 计数器在循环之前归零，不是在循环里面。把 total = 0 往下挪一行，程序照样跑、照样打三个数，而且是错的：每来一个字符计数就重置一次，答案永远只能是 0 或 1。这是最常见的计数 bug，而且它从不报错。
拿 in 去测一个字符在不在 vowels 这个字符串里，是对字符串做成员测试，也就是子串查找。它在这里成立，只是因为每个元音恰好都是一个字符长。同一个运算符也会告诉你 "gram" in "Programming" 是 True。一旦你要找的东西长过一个字符，bug 就从这里来，而解法是把它们放进 set 或 list，而不是字符串。
喂它空串，循环体执行零次，函数返回它一开始的那个 0。「循环一次都没跑」是一个正常且正确的结果，不是需要在开头加个 if 特判的边界情况。早点把这个反射建立起来，后面能省掉大量不必要的防守。

lineNotes.en: Both cases listed, because membership is case-sensitive. The alternative is text.lower() once before the loop - one decision, made in one place either way.
lineNotes.zh: 大小写都列了，因为成员测试区分大小写。另一种做法是在循环前 text.lower() 一次——无论哪种，都是一个决定，做在一个地方。

lineNotes.en: Before the loop. This single line is the difference between a counter and a flag. The step below uses +=, the idiom you will meet everywhere - and in every mark scheme. Adding one with += is the same operation as writing total = total + 1 out in full; += is just the short way to say "add this to what is already there".
lineNotes.zh: 在循环之前。就这一行，决定了它是个计数器还是个标志位。下面那一步用的是 +=——你在别处、在每一份评分方案上都会遇到的惯用写法。用 += 加一，和把它完整写成 total = total + 1 是同一个操作，+= 只是「把这个加到已经有的东西上」的简写。

blurb.en: What a value is, what it becomes, and the three places Python declines to guess for you.
blurb.zh: 一个值是什么、会变成什么，以及 Python 拒绝替你猜的那三处。

en: "3" + "4" prints 34 and raises nothing at all. The + operator is overloaded: between strings it joins, between numbers it adds, and both are legitimate. That is precisely why a forgotten int() around an input() shows up as nonsense output rather than a crash - the crash would have been the kinder outcome. Mix the types, though, and "3" + 4 does raise TypeError: Python guesses in neither direction.

"42" == 42 is False. Python will not convert across types to make a comparison succeed; it answers "not equal" and moves on. So a string that should have been an int does not announce itself, it just quietly takes the branch you did not intend.

int() on a float truncates toward zero: int(-3.9) is -3, not -4. That is a different operation from -3.9 // 1, which floors to -4.0. Truncation and flooring agree on positive numbers and disagree on negative ones, which is why the difference stays hidden until the day it does not.
zh: "3" + "4" 打出 34，而且什么都不抛。+ 是重载的：在字符串之间是拼接，在数字之间是相加，两者都正当。这恰恰是为什么忘了给 input() 套 int() 会表现为「输出是一堆胡话」而不是崩溃——崩溃本来是更仁慈的结果。但类型一混，"3" + 4 就真的会抛 TypeError：Python 朝哪个方向都不猜。
"42" == 42 是 False。Python 不会为了让比较成功而跨类型转换；它回答「不相等」，然后继续往下走。于是一个本该是 int 的字符串不会自报家门，它只是安静地走了你没打算走的那个分支。
int() 作用在浮点上是朝零截断：int(-3.9) 是 -3，不是 -4。这和 -3.9 // 1 是两回事，后者向下取整得到 -4.0。截断和向下取整在正数上一致、在负数上分道扬镳——所以这个差别会一直藏着，直到它不再藏着的那天。

lineNotes.en: !r asks for repr() instead of str(), which is what puts the quotes around '42' and makes a string distinguishable from the number 42 in the output. The other half of the line is .__name__: type(42) on its own prints as <class 'int'>, and .__name__ takes just the bare name out of it, 'int'. Print type(42) yourself and you will see the longer form - that is the same object, not a different answer.
lineNotes.zh: !r 要的是 repr() 而不是 str()，正是它给 '42' 加上了引号，让输出里的字符串和数字 42 能被分辨开。这一行的另一半是 .__name__：单写 type(42) 打出来是 <class 'int'>，而 .__name__ 只把里头那个光秃秃的名字取出来，也就是 'int'。你自己 print(type(42)) 会看到那个长的写法——那是同一个对象，不是另一个答案。

lineNotes.en: False then True. The cast is the entire difference, and nothing in between warned you.
lineNotes.zh: 先 False 后 True。差别全在那一次转换上，而中间没有任何东西提醒过你。

lineNotes.en: 3 and -3. Toward zero from both sides - int() is not rounding and never was.
lineNotes.zh: 3 和 -3。两边都朝零走——int() 不是四舍五入，从来都不是。

run.expect:
'42' -> str
42 -> int
42.0 -> float
'3.5' -> str
34
7
False True
3 -3

blurb.en: Turning seconds into h:mm:ss, and the three results in the output that look wrong and are not.
blurb.zh: 把秒数变成 h:mm:ss；外加输出里那三个看着像错了、其实没错的结果。

en: // and % are one operation seen from two sides: how many whole times it goes in, and what is left over. That is why divmod() returns both from a single call - it is not a convenience wrapper, it is the shape of the underlying operation. Line one of the function uses divmod, the blanked lines use // and % separately; they compute the same pair.

Look at 3 1 -4 1 in the output. Python's % takes the sign of the divisor, so -7 % 2 is 1, not -1, and -7 // 2 is -4, not -3. The invariant Python preserves is (a // b) * b + (a % b) == a, and it checks out: -4 * 2 + 1 == -7. C and Java made the opposite choice, so an algorithm copied between them changes its answers on negative inputs without changing a character.

The last line holds two different surprises that get blamed on each other. round(2.5) is 2 while round(3.5) is 4, because Python rounds a half to the nearest even neighbour - that keeps long columns of numbers from drifting upward the way always-round-up does. But round(2.675, 2) giving 2.67 is not that rule at all: 2.675 simply is not exactly 2.675 in binary, and the value being rounded is a hair below the half. Two results, two unrelated causes.
zh: // 和 % 是同一个运算的两面：整整装得下几次，以及剩下多少。所以 divmod() 一次调用就把两个都还给你——它不是顺手包一层的便利函数，它就是底层那个运算的形状。函数第一行用的是 divmod，被挖空的两行分开用 // 和 %；它们算的是同一对数。
看输出里那行 3 1 -4 1。Python 的 % 取除数的符号，所以 -7 % 2 是 1 不是 -1，而 -7 // 2 是 -4 不是 -3。Python 守住的恒等式是 (a // b) * b + (a % b) == a，代进去验一下：-4 * 2 + 1 == -7。C 和 Java 当年选了相反的方向，于是一个算法在两者之间抄来抄去、一个字符都没改，在负数输入上的答案就变了。

最后一行藏着两个互不相干、却总被算到彼此头上的意外。round(2.5) 是 2 而 round(3.5) 是 4，因为 Python 把「恰好一半」round 到最近的偶数邻居——这能让长长一列数不像「逢半进一」那样整体向上漂。但 round(2.675, 2) 得到 2.67 完全不是这条规则：2.675 在二进制里本来就不是精确的 2.675，被 round 的那个值比一半低了一丝。两个结果，两个无关的成因。

lineNotes.en: One call, two results, one pass over the arithmetic. The name rest says what the second value is for: it is the input to the next split - what is left after the hours have been taken out, and the only thing the rest of the function is allowed to measure. Working from total again below happens to agree here only because 3600 is a multiple of 60; leaning on that coincidence is how this pattern breaks on units that do not divide evenly.
lineNotes.zh: 一次调用、两个结果、算术只走一遍。rest 这个名字说明了第二个值的用途：它是下一次拆分的输入——小时被取走之后剩下的那一段，也是这个函数往下唯一该去量的东西。下面若改回从 total 出发，在这里恰好也对，只因为 3600 是 60 的倍数；依赖这个巧合，正是这个套路在「除不尽的单位」上出事的方式。

lineNotes.en: The most common use of % is not the remainder itself but the yes/no question around it: n % 2 == 0 is how you ask whether n is even, and n % k == 0 is how you ask whether k divides n.
lineNotes.zh: % 最常见的用途不是余数本身，而是围着它问的那个是非题：n % 2 == 0 就是「n 是不是偶数」，n % k == 0 就是「k 能不能整除 n」。

lineNotes.en: 142 and 6: ** binds tighter than //, so this is 1000 // 7, not 10 ** (3 // 7), which would be 1.

blurb.en: A format spec is a tiny language with a fixed word order. Learn the order once and you can read any of them.
blurb.zh: 格式规格是一门语序固定的微型语言。语序学一次，以后任何一个都读得懂。

en: Everything after the colon is a format spec, and its parts always come in the same order: fill, align, sign, width, comma, precision, type. So >10,.3f reads left to right as "right-aligned, ten columns wide, thousands separators, three decimal places, fixed-point". Every part can be left out; the order cannot be rearranged. (One part is not independently optional: fill is only legal immediately before an align. format(1, "*>5") gives '****1', but format(1, "*5") raises ValueError.) Read them in that order and none of them is mysterious.

Alignment has different defaults depending on what you are formatting: numbers align right, strings align left. That is why a column of prices lines up by accident and a column of names does not - until you write an alignment such as <10 and stop leaving it to chance. Writing the alignment out explicitly is the difference between a table that happens to look right today and one that stays right.

The last line prints 0.30000000000000004. The format spec did not create that, it only stopped hiding it: 0.1 and 0.2 have no exact binary form, so their sum is not exactly 0.3. A format spec decides how many digits you show; it never changes the number you have. Which is why floats get compared with a tolerance and rounded only at the moment of printing.
zh: 冒号后面的整串是格式规格，各部分的先后永远固定：填充、对齐、符号、宽度、逗号、精度、类型。所以 >10,.3f 从左往右读就是「右对齐、宽十列、加千位分隔、三位小数、定点表示」。每一部分都可以省，顺序不能变。（有一处不是独立可省的：填充字符只有紧跟在对齐符前面才合法——format(1, "*>5") 得到 '****1'，而 format(1, "*5") 直接抛 ValueError。）按这个顺序读，没有一部分是神秘的。
对齐的默认值随被格式化的东西而不同：数字靠右，字符串靠左。所以一列价格是碰巧对齐的，一列名字则不是——直到你写下像 <10 这样的对齐，不再把它交给运气。把对齐明写出来，就是「今天碰巧好看的表」和「一直不会歪的表」之间的差别。
最后一行打出 0.30000000000000004。格式规格没有制造它，只是不再替它遮掩：0.1 和 0.2 都没有精确的二进制写法，它们的和也就不是精确的 0.3。格式规格决定你显示几位数字，它从不改变你手上的那个数。这正是浮点数要带容差比较、并且只在打印那一刻才 round 的理由。

lineNotes.en: Four specs, no separators between them. The widths are the layout - each field pads itself to its own column, which is why nothing here needs a tab or a run of spaces.
lineNotes.zh: 四个规格，中间没有任何分隔符。宽度本身就是版式——每个字段把自己填到各自那一列，所以这里不需要任何制表符或一长串空格。

lineNotes.en: The comma alone, with no precision and no type. It works on ints as well as floats, and it is locale-independent: always a comma, never a dot.
lineNotes.zh: 只有一个逗号，不带精度也不带类型。它对 int 和 float 都管用，而且与地区设置无关：永远是逗号，绝不会变成点。

lineNotes.en: An expression inside the braces, formatted on the way out. The braces take any expression, not just a variable name.
lineNotes.zh: 花括号里是一个表达式，出来的路上顺手格式化。花括号能装任何表达式，不只是一个变量名。
